title: Ulyana and the Ember
author: Zephyrine Oyelaran
blurb: Freya Okafor, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
